approved_tools.name: Marks at the Gate
approved_tools.purpose: Students make one mark for each cow that leaves and strike out one mark for each cow that returns. Include the textbook question: "Did all the cows come back home?"

approved_tools.name: Count the Big Herd
approved_tools.purpose: Use the exact textbook tally: nine groups of five and two extra marks = 47 cows. Students identify why Deba and Deep were worried, how many cows were still out (2), and how many reached home (45).
approved_tools.flow_row: Topic 2: Marks Left on the Wall

approved_tools.name: Hemant's Cows and Sheep
approved_tools.purpose: Students make separate tally records for 36 cows and 23 sheep. Do not combine the two totals.
approved_tools.flow_row: Topic 2: Marks Left on the Wall

approved_tools.name: Longest and Shortest Names
approved_tools.purpose: One focused activity with three short stages: animal team captains; compare Mahesh and Kartik; compare the names students enter for the friends' name activity. Cover the related textbook questions without adding new questions.
approved_tools.flow_row: Topic 3: How Long Is a Name?

approved_tools.name: Starting and Ending Letters
approved_tools.purpose: Students identify their own starting letter, sort the textbook name set by starting and ending letters, count matching names, find the most-used starting letter and identify letters not used at the start.

approved_tools.name: Build a Number Name
approved_tools.purpose: Cover the textbook examples 43 and 17, then let students use their own roll number. The notebook task to write more number names is shown as a short optional instruction card, not a separate tool.

approved_tools.name: Number Name Puzzles
approved_tools.purpose: Cover the textbook tasks: numbers with eight letters, longest number names, the near-100 clue and the smallest name from 63 to 78. Accept all valid answers: 93, 97 and 98 for the near-100 clue; 70 for the 63 to 78 clue. Show a short instruction card for making a similar puzzle in the notebook.
approved_tools.flow_row: Topic 6: Number Puzzles and Place Names

approved_tools.name: Group the Cards Two Ways
approved_tools.purpose: One tool focused on grouping by a rule, with three short stages: identify Jojo's rule (things that fly / do not fly); sort the eight household objects by electricity use; regroup the same eight objects using another valid rule. Accept multiple sensible groupings in the final stage.
